name: mcp-lyricscom
description: MCP server for lyrics.com. Search song lyrics by word or by title, and fetch full lyrics. No API key required.
long_description: Find a song from a word inside its lyrics, or by title, then read the full text. No API key, no account.

tools.name: search_lyrics
tools.description: Find songs containing a word or phrase in their lyrics.

query.description: Word or short phrase to look for inside the lyrics, for example 'autrefois'.

limit.description: Maximum songs to return from this page.

page.description: Result page on lyrics.com. Each page holds up to 24 raw results.

verify.description: How to confirm the query really appears in the lyrics. 'snippet' checks the excerpt lyrics.com already returned and costs nothing. 'full' fetches up to 5 song pages and checks the complete lyrics, which is slow and can trigger rate limiting. 'none' disables filtering.

include_excerpt.description: Include the matching lyric line excerpt in each result.

tools.name: search_songs
tools.description: Find songs by title, optionally narrowed by artist.

title.description: Song title, or part of it.

artist.description: Optional artist name, matched case-insensitively against each result.

match.description: 'strict' keeps only results whose title matches the query as a whole title, ignoring suffixes such as '(Remastered)'. 'loose' keeps anything lyrics.com returned, best match first.

tools.name: get_lyrics
tools.description: Read one song's lyrics by id.

id.description: lyrics.com numeric song id, as returned by the search tools. Preferred over 'url'.

url.description: Full lyrics.com song URL. Only www.lyrics.com URLs are accepted. Ignored when 'id' is given.

max_chars.description: Maximum characters of lyrics text to return in this call.

offset.description: Character offset to resume from, for lyrics longer than max_chars.

highlight.description: Optional word. When set, the response reports whether it appears in the lyrics and on which line.
